definitions.explanation: The hair growing on a person's head. More specific than 髪 alone.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}の{毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{髪|かみ}の{毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
{髪|かみ}の{毛|け}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧。
examples.english: I wash my hair and then dry it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{髪|かみ}の{毛|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配：00811_shinpai⟧。
examples.english: Lately my hair has been falling out more often, and I'm a little worried.

notes:
{髪|かみ}の{毛|け} specifically refers to hair on the head.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {髪|かみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut hair)
- {髪|かみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ (to wash hair)
- {髪|かみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (hair falls out)
- {髪|かみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (hair grows)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: hair (general, also means hairstyle)
- {髪|かみ}の{毛|け}: individual hairs, or hair as substance
- ⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧: hair, fur (body hair, animal fur)

COUNTER: ⟦{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ for individual strands
